verdict.rationale: Document verification is a fair question for a KYC/AML compliance platform like ComplyAdvantage, so this story applies to it. However, the evidence covers only sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, monitoring, exports and transaction monitoring. Nothing shows document verification sessions or API retrieval of extracted ID fields such as name, DOB, document number, address or expiry. Screening results (e.g. screening_result hits) are a different capability and are not credited here.
